entries.name: (Disease) Rosalia Virus
entries.content:
The Rosalia Virus is a Group V RNA virus of the Filoviridae family, similar to other hemorrhagic fever-causing agents like the Marburg and Ebola viruses.

The Rosalia virus causes severe viral hemorrhagic fever, meaning that death happens extremely quickly. The virus has the side effect of affecting the mental stability of its victims if it infects the nervous system, causing auditory and visual hallucinations.

The virus is named after Rosalia Rossellini, the asymptomatic host of the blood in which was first found by Albert Sartre. The virus is capable of surviving in the body of its host long after death, while also multiplying and retaining its virulent nature. This is assumed to be because of its unique composition of nucleic acid, making it a new type of organism. This quality was what piqued Albert's interests, and he hoped to reengineer the virus to selectively attack only malignant cells, effectively putting an end to all disease.

However, in its original and fundamental state, it spreads ruthlessly, attacking both healthy and infected cells. In researching this possibility.

The Rosalia Virus, being a hemorrhagic fever, is capable of killing patients in a matter of days. It has two stages in development, both a dark (undetectable) and active phase.

The Dark Stage involves the cells fragmenting, slowly infecting its host. This stage cannot be confirmed by any means, making treatment virtually impossible. However, unexplained or abnormal tumor formations can act as an indicator for this stage. The tumor suppressant gene is inhibited at this stage, allowing these barely noticeable tumors to form. Then, the virus-infected cells replicate, forming unique, malignant tumors, generally on the outside of the organs.

Once the virus replicates itself enough, it then moves onto the active phase. The virus, which was fragmented in the Dark Stage, merge together to recreate its full form. This form attaches to organs and blood vessels, forming colonies on the body. These colonies have a distinct, smooth, gem-like texture which are black, red and purple in color. A concentration of these colonies develop into bruise-like clusters forming on the exterior and interior of organs in the later part of this stage. Once a colony reaches a certain size, the tumor bursts, metastasizing and further infecting other parts of the body. This metastasis spreads the virus uncontrollably and indiscriminately, causing it to travel all over the body. Massive bleeding begins from any orifice in the body, including the eyes. This mass infection, as well as the loss of organ control and vital signs that follow, ultimately kill the patient. It is stated that the patient will only last three days at most after the colonies' explosion, since tumor/colony excision will not eradicate the virus.

entries.name: (Disease) Twisted Rosalia
entries.content:
Twisted Rosalia is a hybrid of Rosalia and GUILT. Specifically, its location in the heart and its wormlike nature are reminiscent of Paraskevi, while the virus's shell on the heart and the increasing colonies atop the shell are reminiscent of Pempti. In addition, destroying the shell results in the fragments of the shell to cause lacerations to the heart, similar to Savato.

However, the pervasive nature of the Rosalia Virus does have one drawback for itself and the disorder/disease it comes into contact with. Because Rosalia effectively incorporates the existing disorder - in this case, GUILT - and makes them into one entity, removing one removes them both.

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) Professor Albert Sartre
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Albert Sartre]
Gender: [Male]
Occupation: [Professor of Virology]
Character Description: [Professor Albert Sartre was a professor of virology at Cumberland College and the adoptive father of Rosalia and CR-S01. Albert was the person responsible for the Cumberland College Incident, though the incident was blamed on CR-S01. He was the first person to discover and contract the Rosalia Virus, leading to his constant use of antiviral medication. He studied the virus and Rosalia's blood, believing that he could re-engineer its selective destructive qualities to cure every disease in existence, but eventually realized that the rampant aspects of the virus could not be overcome. The infection slowly drove him insane (as several Forensics victims had exhibited), and to prevent the disease from spreading, he shot and killed its host, Rosalia, though not in cold blood. Ironically, his actions allowed for the Rosalia Virus to spread, via the vector of monarch butterflies shedding scales on their migration route to Lake Erie. Albert died from the Rosalia Virus due to an attack that led to a lethal amount of blood loss from massive hemorrhaging throughout his body. Presumably dying alone two years prior to the Rosalia pandemic, he begged his son for forgiveness with his dying breath. His remains were discovered in the Back Cove area of Portland during the quarantine, and were taken into government custody for examination. The Marine researcher assigned to the autopsy began to exhibit strange symptoms, causing Jacob Tillman to call for Gabriel Cunningham's assistance in identifying the pathogen carried by the bones. Gabe smuggled the remains out of the government facility and brought them to Resurgam, where he, Naomi Kimishima, and Little Guy were able to reassemble the remains and deduce his identity.]

entries.name: Cumberland College Incident
entries.content:
The Cumberland College Incident was a mass casualty that occurred in the year 2012, at the Cumberland College in Portland, Maine. It is the crime for which CR-S01 was convicted, although inconclusively, carrying a sentence of 250 years in prison.

Albert Sartre, a professor of virology, and his adopted son and apprentice Erhard (later known as CR-S01), were both present at the time of the incident. The exact nature of the disaster is unclear, and details such as the number of victims vary, but what is known is that there was a massive freak breakout of some sort of pathogen that instantly killed a large number of people on the college campus. This is implied to have been enacted by lethal gases, or perhaps by airborne disease. Among the dead were Holden's wife, a professor at the college, and young daughter.

Erhard and his father had been doing experiments with lab rats, mostly with what appears to be the Rosalia Virus contained in syringes. The rats suffered massive, telltale black bruises and almost instant death by bleeding out. CR-S01's hazy recollection of the incident spoke of "mountains of corpses, blood everywhere", indicating that the campus may in fact have been the first site of widespread Rosalia virus pandemic.

Albert Sartre is shown to have injected his adopted son with an amnesia-inducing agent after the breakout, and left the boy behind to take the fall for the disaster, and then fled to Mexico with adopted daughter Rosalia to continue research on the pathogen in her blood. However, he shows incredible remorse for this act.

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) Rosalia Rossellini
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Rosalia Rossellini]
Gender: [Female]
Age: [15]
Character Description: [Rosalia Rossellini is CR-S01's adopted sister, Albert Sartre's adopted daughter, and Maria Torres' friend while she was staying in the orphanage. She was saved by her during a fire that Maria accidentally started in an orphanage. Rosalia was the natural host to the Rosalia Virus, and held a cure to it within her blood. She was killed by Albert Sartre, and her body was preserved in adipocere among Asclepias Flowers, which became the new host to the Rosalia Virus. During the pandemic, Naomi and Maria went to Mexico and made an antiserum from the flowers around her corpse that had absorbed her blood, and used the antiserum to cure the Rosalia Virus. Rosalia stayed with Albert Sartre in Mexico while he searched for a cure within her blood. He started experimenting with the blood of Rosalia which caused him to get infected with the Rosalia Virus. Albert tried desperately and as fast as he could to finish the antiserum, but sadly lost his sanity due to the effects of the Rosalia Virus. In his crazed state, Albert thought that by killing Rosalia, he would prevent the Rosalia Virus from spreading. He attempted to shoot her while he was at his desk, but missed Rosalia and hit the window, shattering the glass. Rosalia, figuring out that Albert was out to kill her, ran outside, stepping on shattered glass. She then tried to flee, but was stopped when Albert fired another shot in her right leg. This caused her to collapse on the ground and allow Albert to catch up. While Albert pointed his gun, Rosalia raised her hand, in an act of defensive instinct, but could not prevent the bullet from passing through her hand and into her heart, killing her.]

entries.name: (Character: Second Opinion/UtK, Trauma Team) Navel
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: Under the Knife/Second Opinion, Trauma Team]
Name: [Navel]
Alias: [Little Guy]
Gender: [Male]
Occupation: [Assistant, FBI Agent]
Physical Appearance: [Navel is a man with an average build. He has short blonde hair and blue eyes. He wears an all blue suit, with the jacket, pants, and tie all being the same color, while his dress shirt is a darker shade of blue.]
Personality: [For the most part, Navel is a calm and collected person. He rarely, if ever, get's riled up, and has a mostly aloof personality. Navel often makes sarcastic remarks and uses offensive humor.]
Character Description: [Navel, also known as "Little Guy", is the assistant to Naomi Kimishima. He acts as Naomi's personal aide, something of a liaison between her and Delphi. He supervises and sometimes assists Naomi's operations, working as a chauffeur for her as well. Little is ever mentioned about who he is or what his reasons for working for Delphi are. When Caduceus USA makes its raid on Delphi, he makes it quite clear to Naomi that they "won't meet again". However, Navel comes back sometime later as an FBI agent, dispatched to cooperate with Naomi during investigations. Despite an awkward start, Navel and Naomi work together quite well. He is called solely "Little Guy" by Naomi, a nickname he doesn't appear to resent. During their partnership, Little Guy constantly hints towards an active romantic interest in Naomi, but nothing ever appears to come from it, although on occasion Naomi flirts back. It is suggested that Little Guy somehow faked his way into the FBI.]

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) Ian Holden
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Ian Holden]
Gender: [Male]
Occupation: [FBI Agent/Retainer]
Character Description: [Holden is the FBI representative who provides CR-S01 the opportunity to work off his 250-year prison sentence by performing difficult surgeries. His past and motivation in regards to CR-S01 is revealed piecemeal. Maria Torres questions him about a photo in his wallet, that he was reflecting on during a procedure. He explains it is his daughter, who "would have been 14 now", and that she had passed away along with his wife eight years prior in the Cumberland College Incident. Holden had, in fact, been the man to apprehend CR-S01, but as he notes to Gabriel Cunningham, "all we do is catch criminals... we don't decide their fate." While it would appear that Holden would bear an enormous grudge against CR-S01 for his apparent role in his wife and daughter's death, it seems rather that the eight years of incarceration have convinced him that the prisoner is, in fact, innocent. The few times he is seen interacting with the young man, he seems to be empathetic (perhaps even father-like) toward him. During an elaborate "escape" attempt from Resurgam facilitated by CR-S01's fellow doctors, Holden asks Gabriel Cunningham to "not make his situation any worse". Holden seems to be the direct superior of Navel, and by association, Naomi Kimishima, both of whom's pasts he appears to be familiar with. He is the first to imply knowledge of Naomi and Navel's past with Delphi, as well as of her terminal genetic disorder, and may have been Navel's way into the FBI after defecting from the terrorist faction. He holds this fact over their heads in asking them to take care of the Raging Bomber case.]

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) Maria Torres
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Maria Torres]
Gender: [Female]
Age: [25]
Occupation: [Paramedic]
Physical Appearance: [Maria is a young adult woman with dark skin, short dark brown hair, and green eyes. She wears a black tank top under a yellow-green jacket with goggles hanging around her neck, yellow gloves, hot pants with a belt, and black and yellow boots.]
Personality: [Maria has a fiery temperament, often lashing out angrily at people around her when they make mistakes or when she feels they are holding her back. She has a tendency to address people offensively (using words like moron, idiot, etc) but she does not mean this in harm, and has the same desire to save lives as the other members of the trauma team do.]
Character Description: [Maria Torres is a professional paramedic. Maria strives to become a hero, but often fights with her co-workers due to her overly independent attitude. She enjoys yelling at subordinates. At the age of 14, Maria was smoking in the bathroom of her orphanage when things "got out of hand", causing a fire. This led Maria to save a girl named Rosalia Rossellini, without a second thought after she heard her screams within the burning building. This inspired Maria to become a hero, and set her on the path to become a paramedic.]

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) Dr. Gabriel "Gabe" Cunningham
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Gabriel "Gabe" Cunningham]
Gender: [Male]
Occupation: [Diagnostician]
Physical Appearance: [Gabe is an adult man with a messy hairstyle and tendency to smoke cigarettes.]
Personality: [Gabe is a very sarcastic and cynical person. Unlike the other members of the Trauma Team, he is less open about wanting to save lives. He notes that he isn't very good with the "mushy" stuff, implying that his constant lack of positive emotions caused him to drift apart from his family. Nevertheless, when he realizes that his patients may have very grave conditions, he doesn't hesitate to do everything in his power to give them a complete diagnosis (and thus the correct procedure to undergo), even if his patients happen to be less than cooperative.]
Character Description: [Dr. Gabriel "Gabe" Cunningham is a skilled diagnostician. Dubbed as the "Master of Deduction", his skills in deduction within diagnostics are unmatched, often being calm, cool, and collected in most situations. He has an ex-wife and a son named Joshua, who was operated on in Tomoe Tachibana's first operation. He is almost never seen without a cigarette in his mouth (even in inappropriate situations such as the shower or dangerous situations such as holding on to the rope dangling from a flying helicopter). His ashtray within his office is often filled with cigarettes.]

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) Tomoe Tachibana
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Tomoe Tachibana]
Gender: [Female]
Occupation: [Endoscopic Surgeon]
Character Description: [Tomoe Tachibana is a endoscopic surgeon. The daughter of Yoshikage Tachibana, Tomoe came to America to work in endoscopy, all the while following the "Path of Honor." Tomoe Tachibana is the heir to the Tachibana clan and a skilled endoscopic surgeon. However, her views directly contradict those of her father's, whose plan is to provide a husband for her. The two gradually set apart, and with one final heated argument, she leaves for America. Despite her emphatic profession that she wants to build a life for herself independent from the Tachibana clan, she brings along much of her family fortune, a full retinue of household staff, and her faithful butler, Hanzou Kanadamaru. In America, her unmatched skills led her to become the leading endoscopic surgeon at Resurgam First Care, performing various complicated operations for the hospital. Tomoe uses a one-of-a-kind set of endoscopic tools she had custom built and has trained with in Japan. Her skill proves a valuable asset to the team, being well-supported by her colleagues. In spite of this, her love for the culture of the Tachibana clan never strayed off from her sight, and she frequently shows this in her demeanor and personality. In her 'free' life, she is visited in the night by messengers of her father, urging her to come home. She puts the matter off, promising to come home once her affairs are sorted out in Resurgam. She flies back to Japan, with the clan elders dealing with the possible future for the clan. Her father decides that she should get married, and that he will choose a husband for her. Before she can reply, the Cheif and Gabe interrupt the family meeting to protest Tomoe's presumed fate. The elders are outraged, and Yoshikage collapses, leaving the three doctors to come to his aid. Tomoe's skills save him from a ruptured bulla in his lung, and she subsequently disappears from his sight, already leaving for America. She leaves Hanzou behind to take care of her father, but Yoshikage orders him to look after Tomoe. On the way home, Hanzou catches up to the plane, and they all return to America. Tomoe is very skilled both physically and mentally. Her skills in her line of work allow her to navigate tight passages and complete surgery in the nick of time. She is also very creative, seen when she uses the endoscope to search for hidden victims in a pile of rubble after a bus charges into a mall. Her physical skills involve swift, ninja-like maneuvers such as seemingly disappearing from sight and appearing in a different location in the blink of an eye. She is also proficient in weaponry, as seen when she swiftly grabs a naginata from her butler's hands and points it at a ninja messenger, as well as when she fires an arrow into her target right in front of Gabriel.]

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) CR-S01
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Erhard Muller]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [24]
Occupation: [Surgeon]
Physical Appearance: [CR-S01 is an adult man with red eyes and wears a white jumpsuit with black buttons. He has a visitor's card on his neck and wears a white coat with a cape-like style at the back.]
Personality: [Ever since he was a child, CR-S01 was said to be emotionless, with even his parents fearing him. He is described as emotionless. He never feels happy, even when receiving praise due to his amazing surgical skills. He is also humorless and straightforward. Despite this, CR-S01 is highly focused and determined during operations. In a (seemingly) ironic twist, CR-S01 selflessly determined to rescue every patient in front of him, as he was nearly accused of attempting an escape. CR-S01 eventually develops a more feeling nature, the first occurrence happening when he cried as agent Holden convinced him to pursue his dream to save lives. Then, when he returns to his prison, he showed a slight smile. At the end of Tomoe's final operation, CR-S01 smiled. At first, he denies that he smiled, but in the end, he laughed along with Maria and the other staff in the operating room. In spite of his foster father being responsible for framing him, CR-S01 holds his father in great respect in trying to eradicate all diseases.]
Character Description: [CR-S01 is a prodigy surgeon. He was serving a prison sentence of 250 years due to alleged bioterrorism, but thanks to the efforts of Holden, CR-S01 was given temporary release and resumed his career as a surgeon in exchange for reduced sentence time. CR-S01 was despised and feared by his parents, who were disturbed by his apparent lack of emotion, even going as far to say that they believed he would "kill them one day." Both of CR-S01's parents died of unmentioned causes while he was still young, and he was adopted by Albert Sartre, who later also became his teacher and mentor. Albert would also adopt Rosalia Rossellini when CR-S01 was 14 years old. Initially, Albert was a professor of virology at Cumberland College. CR-S01 supported his research, which involved extracting a filovirus present in Rosalia's blood and modifying it to use as a cure for all diseases. However, there was an accidental breakout of the Rosalia Virus in 2012, caused by Albert, which is later referred to as the Cumberland College Incident. The event caused a massive number of casualties, and Albert is believed to have injected CR-S01 with an amnesia-inducing agent, causing him to pass out. Regardless of his amnesia, CR-S01 was held in trial, and received a 250 year imprisonment sentence on charges of committing bioterrorism. Despite his sentence, CR-S01 did not resent Albert, since he believed that it was he who gave him the training and knowledge that he needed to save lives.]

entries.name: (Character: New Blood) Dr. Justin Everett
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: New Blood]
Name: [Justin Everett]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [42]
Occupation: [Surgeon]
Physical Appearance: [Everett is a middle aged man with a good stature for his age, with his working uniform consisting of a v-neck scrub and pants.]
Personality: [Justin is down-to-earth and lax, but also hardworking (to a certain fault) as described by Irene in which he prioritized other's needs over his own when he was suffering from his condition for 3 years, almost resulting in near detriment to his body.]
Character Description: [Justin Everett serves as Caduceus USA's chief surgeon.]

entries.name: (Character: New Blood) Robert Cromwell
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: New Blood]
Name: [Robert Cromwell]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [38]
Occupation: [Researcher]
Physical Appearance: [Cromwell is an middle-aged man with his working uniform being similar to Justin Everett's in terms of appearance.]
Personality: [Robert is slightly eccentric and wouldn't hesitate to explain in great detail his or the research team's most recent breakthroughs in the laboratory. Though extremely polite, he tends to annoy people with his long-winded explanations and excessive use of scientific jargon.]
Character Description: [Robert Cromwell serves as Caduceus USA's head researcher.]

entries.name: (Character: New Blood) Hans Nilsen
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: New Blood]
Name: [Hans Nilsen]
Gender: [Male]
Occupation: [Director of Humani]
Character Description: [Hans Nilsen is the Director of Humani, a pharmaceutical company that aids Caduceus USA. He's seen Markus, Valerie, and Elena's appearance on the Miracle Surgery TV show, and was impressed on their performance and speech given near the end of it. He offers the three box seats to a hockey game as a token of appreciation, being accompanied with Isabella Vazquez as well. He's shocked at Stigma's properties after reading Cynthia's reports on how Culurium is a potential factor of it. He worries about his company and products because they are reliant on it.]

entries.name: Culurium
entries.content: Culurium is a rare metal alloy, with Stigma needing the alloy to survive. It is also used as the heme for artificial blood, and other medical breakthroughs. As time goes on, Stigma mutates and can persist without it.

entries.name: (Character: New Blood) Isabella Vazquez
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: New Blood]
Name: [Isabella Vazquez]
Gender: [Female]
Occupations: [Representative of Humani, Researcher at Caduceus]
Personality: [Isabella has a tendency to display a somewhat lax, immature and unprofessional view towards her work, tending to interrupt others with no regards to reading the room. She also depicts a flirtatious nature towards some of her coworkers, sometimes as a result disrupting them. It's also shown she has little to no regards to an appropriate state of formal wear. Despite this, she is apparently a shrewd businesswoman who can play hardball when needed, and displays kindness and care towards her friends, even eschewing her professional duty for them when needed.]
Character Description: [Isabella Vazquez is a representative of Humani, a major pharmaceuticals company, who is also employed as a researcher at Caduceus.]

entries.name: (Character: New Blood) Guy Davidson
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: New Blood]
Name: [Guy Davidson]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [54]
Occupations: [Host for Wish Come True: Miracle Surgery, News Reporter]
Physical Appearance: [Davidson is a middle-aged man whose formal wear consists of a brown blazer, slacks and dress-shirt of a darker shade along with a yellow tie. He also wears a metallic ring.]
Personality: [Because of TV shows demanding a loud and dramatic feel Davidson's personality reflects this, taking praise and adding his own personal flair to heighten the drama, stopping at nothing to increase the show's ratings. He also focuses on delivering information on the operations, occasionally distracting other visiting surgeons such as Valerie and Markus. Upon the show ending and his employment as a news reporter, he seems to have mellowed out.]
Character Description: [Guy Davidson is the host for the TV show "Miracle Surgery". After the show is shut down, he becomes a news anchor.]

entries.name: (Character: New Blood) Maria Estrada
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: New Blood]
Name: [Maria Estrada]
Gender: [Female]
Age: [24]
Occupation: [Doctor]
Personality: [Maria is eager and willing to learn and better herself the best she can. Despite her hard work she has a tendency to be slightly careless, with her having neglected her shots despite being born in a country with an endemic contagion thinking that her natural immunity would be enough.]
Character Description: [Maria Estrada is a doctor in training, serving for the Culuruma base camp. Having went to the US and doing a residency there, she has thoughts of practicing her trade in her homeland instead. She acts as an interpreter to Markus, Valerie and Elena. Shortly after her introduction she remarks about feeling ill, with the three theorizing that she may have been struck with a case of Vaimahse Fever due to her having returned to the country after a number of years and having never taken the immunization shots. After being treated, she decides to follow the three on their inquiries. After a trip to a nearby village, she converses with a villager regarding Stigma, its whereabouts and a mine. She and the three leave and return to camp where Maria is then given a demonstration on Stigma by them.]

entries.name: (Character: Second Opinion/UtK) Langston Miller
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: Under the Knife/Second Opinion]
Name: [Langston Miller]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [51]
Occupations: [Director of Caduceus Europe]
Physical Appearance: [Langston is a middle aged man sporting a blond styled hairstyle along with a selleck mustache, with his appearance overall showing a fair amount of age. His suit's design resembles an ordinary appearance save for the varying decorative adornments and the Caduceus logo.]
Personality: [Langston upholds himself in a professional manner, especially during conferences with him having a good deal of knowledge on the topics at hand. When having acquainted with others, however, he takes on a bit of leniency.]
Character Description: [Langston Miller is the British director of Caduceus Europe. Because Caduceus Europe boasts more "advanced" facilities and level of researchers, he uses his influence to advance varying projects to developments almost seen as unfeasible, such examples being keeping sinners as research for GUILT along with using Z-Cells from the pathogens, and combining various technologies in order to treat cancer. Despite the well intentioned actions however they did have their complications, such as the Z-Cells being GUILT cells and the technology failing to differentiate between healthy and cancer cells, thus creating the strain Triti.]

entries.name: (Organization/Location) Concordia Medical Institute
entries.content: Concordia Medical Institute is a hospital located in Los Angeles, California. It is the location where the deadly pathogen, Stigma was accidentally created by Markus Vaughn while he was performing experiments on lab rats with Lloyd Wilkens. Time passes and Markus and Valerie come to work at Concordia after Montgomery Memorial Hospital closed. However, their stay there is brief, since they are recruited by Irene Quatro to work at Caduceus USA after Prof Wilkens is kidnapped. After the abduction of Professor Wilkens, part of the building was set on fire but it isn't clear what was the cause of it.

entries.name: (Character: Second Opinion/UtK) Victor Niguel
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: Under the Knife/Second Opinion]
Name: [Victor Niguel]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [25]
Occupations: [Researcher]
Physical Appearance: [Victor has short, rather messy hair. He consistently has a bored or angry expression, with bags under his eyes. He is always seen with his arms crossed, and he never smiles. He wears a standard Caduceus outfit.]
Personality: [Victor has a pompous and rude attitude, calling most of the people around him idiots. Victor has a tendency to curse during operations when he sees incompetence or when something goes wrong. He appears to want to get credit for everything, though this may be because he desires to figure out every situation as quickly as possible, hating to be outsmarted by his colleagues. Victor is very easily angered when disrupted during his research.]
Character Description: [Victor Niguel is the head of Research and Development for Caduceus USA.]

entries.name: (Character: Second Opinion/UtK) Dr. Stephen Clarks
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: Under the Knife/Second Opinion]
Name: [Stephen Clarks]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [42]
Occupations: [Surgeon]
Physical Appearance: [Stephen is a middle-aged man who sports a relatively solid look of a full beard and a slightly unkempt state of hairstyle. His usual outfit is composed of blue slacks, a colored dress shirt and a dotted patterned tie.]
Personality: [Being the father of 2 children, Stephen adopts a kind and caring conduct to his patients. His demeanor is never drastic as he always keeps a calm and steady stance during operations.]
Character Description: [Dr. Stephen Clarks was Caduceus' head surgeon until the appearance of Derek Stiles. He was considered to be the best performing doctor in Caduceus until Derek's appearance, in which from then on he serves as second in-command, taking on other relevant tasks as well as serving as backup for surgeries in any case an operation is failed. One of his major operations was on Amy Chase, attempting to treat Deftera, but was somewhat unsuccessful, having only thinned out some of their tumors. He was originally supposed to operate on Linda Reid's Post-Kyriaki but seeing as she preferred Derek, he gave up rights to him instead.]

entries.name: (Character: Second Opinion/UtK) Richard Anderson
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: Under the Knife/Second Opinion]
Name: [Richard Anderson]
Gender: [Male]
Age: [63]
Occupations: [Secretary of Health]
Physical Appearance: [Richard Anderson is a stout old man with graying hair. His main outfit consists of a brown suit, white dress shirt and red tie.]
Personality: [Richard Anderson is a devoted man towards medicine, despite his former endeavors in politics. When facing certain death from Pempti, he stayed strong enough despite the pain, placing his hopes towards Caduceus in hopes of the organization developing a cure.]
Character Description: [Richard Anderson was the head director of Caduceus USA and Secretary of Health, having changed careers after a long endeavor in politics. While giving a speech to a crowd in Angeles Bay's City Hall, an unexpected feeling in his chest caused him to collapse, which he is then transferred to Caduceus. He then wakes up to the presence of Derek, Victor, Angie & Sidney formulating a plan going forwards in regards of the treatment. Victor states that he was the first known person to be infected with Pempti. Because Pempti had not been treated before, he allows Caduceus to use him as a test subject to find out how to treat the pathogen. He had been operated on three times, and even though Derek cured his Pempti, Richard's body could not handle the operations, with him dying as a result. Richard knew he was going to die, so he talked to Robert, telling him that he wanted Robert to take over Caduceus USA. Robert was hesitant because he gave up on operating but shortly afterwards, Robert decided to take over for him as the new director of Caduceus USA.]

entries.name: (Character: Second Opinion/UtK) Linda Reid
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Center: Under the Knife/Second Opinion]
Name: [Linda Reid]
Gender: [Female]
Age: [14]
Occupations: [Student]
Character Description: [Linda Reid is a patient who was the first GUILT patient operated on by Derek before he moved to Caduceus USA, and the lacerations on her lungs were treated. However, the cause of the lacerations was Kyriaki. After her first operation, Linda expressed discontent with the operation as she wanted to die, due to her bad grades, bad social life, and her self proclaimed overweightness. However according to her charts, Linda is perfectly healthy weight-wise. Dr. Stiles told her about a pet cat he once had named Tama, and how he experienced a similar situation after Tama got hit by a car. He, too, wished that he would die, but after his mother told him to apologize to himself for wishing so, he found the will to live. Derek tried the same method with Linda, and it managed to calm her down and stop her death wish. Some time later, while Linda was reconciling with her parents, Greg noticed that her bloodstream contained an unusually high amount of chemicals - high enough to cause the mood swings she expressed. Linda later complained of unbearable chest pain. She pleaded to live, commencing another operation. While investigating her lungs, Derek discovers more lacerations have formed, despite no harm coming to her during her stay at the hospital. Right after the last laceration was treated, another formed, and investigation with the ultrasound revealed that Kyriaki was the cause of it. The GUILT was soon treated, allowing for Linda to recover.]

Personality: [Being the President, he places high importance to caring for the country and his citizens. He is also shown to be harsh, threatening Markus, Valerie and Elena imprisonment under martial law if they refuse to assist his soldiers in battle.]
Character Description: [Moreno is the president of a South American country in which civil war rages. He welcomes Markus, Valerie and Elena upon arrival at the base camp. He states that he is grateful to receive their country's assistance due to Stigma's influence and rumors sending the population into a panic. He doesn't expect that the three are prepared for the situation at hand, which he then orders a Sergeant to bring in a dog, Pepita, as a gift to them. With that, he leaves. He later returns to base, and explains that with the ongoing conflict upon his orders will be launching an attack against the enemy forces, stating that the three's efforts would be well used in helping to tend any injured soldiers. Concluding the battle he thanks the three in their efforts, as well as having detained the fleeing Ramsey Ramirez and two other members of the opposition.]

entries.name: (Character: Trauma Team) Dr. Hank Freebird
entries.content:
Setting: [Trauma Team]
Name: [Hank Freebird]
Gender: [Male]
Occupation: [Orthopedic Surgeon]
Character Description: [Dr. Hank Freebird is an orthopedic surgeon. Hank is a former member of the United States Army, growing tired of taking lives and decided to save them by becoming a surgeon. When he's not working on an operation or tending the flowers on the hospital grounds, and a crime is happening in the city, he turns into a superhero and stops these crimes under the name of "Captain Eagle". In contrast to his slow and careful approach to surgery, as a superhero he is heedless and destructive, causing extensive collateral damage and injuries during his crime-fighting. This reaches the point that the general public assumes that disasters which occurred while Captain Eagle was in the area are his doing. Hank saves a patient named Claire Blunt, who attempted suicide. It has been revealed that he wishes to deliver the message that life is beautiful to those around him. While Claire is initially cold towards him, she eventually warms up to him. His superhero identity, "Captain Eagle," begins receiving bad press. Hank decides to stop being a superhero, but during a trip to the mall with Claire, a shootout occurs, and Claire is shot. She tells Hank that she now wants to live, and seemingly dies in his arms. Hank discovers that the culprit has bone cancer and has no hope of surviving. The man shoots Hank in the chest twice and then passes out after trying to take his own life, and Hank operates on him. He discovers soft tumors within the patient's spinal cord - while he was discouraged from removing them, he finds the resolve to treat the patient's tumors, hoping to give the man the hope he was denied at first. After the operation, Hank is informed that Claire was resuscitated by Maria Torres and survived the incident. Hank continues to fight crime as "Captain Eagle".]
